Backend: 20/20 pytest pass (public content/services, enquiry validation/honeypot/consent/past-date/invalid-service, submission_key dedupe, rate limit 5/10min -> 429, RBAC no-token 401 / pending 403 / staff scoped 404 & 403 on assign/services/content/users, admin status/assign/notes/history, CSV export, service edit/hide/reorder and content edit with revert). Frontend: all 9 public routes render with header/footer, 18+ shown on home/about/footer, no '11+' anywhere; home hero/CTAs/10 explore links/5 why items/CTA headline verified; Services page has exactly 10 categories with exact sub-service lists (7/8/8/7/8/7/7/7/10/14), accordion expand/collapse, warning when nothing selected, WhatsApp URL & message template exact, Clear Selection resets; all 10 detail pages have intro/process/FAQ/enquiry form, WA href with service name, CTA preselects service on /schedule-consultation; contact & booking validation + success reference IDs; booking dblclick sends 1 POST; mobile 390px no horizontal overflow and mobile menu works. Admin UI (tickets): overview stats, search/kind/status filters, drawer status/assign/notes/history, CSV download, services edit CTA/hide/reorder reflected on public site and reverted, content hero edit reflected and reverted, Staff & Access role selects; staff sees only assigned enquiry and only Overview/Enquiries nav, no assign select, /admin/services redirects; pending sees 'Awaiting approval'; session persists on reload; sign-out returns to /sign-in. One real bug: concurrent same-submission_key POSTs return 500.

minor.issue: Race: find_one(submission_key) then insert_one is not atomic. 10 parallel POSTs with same submission_key -> one returned 500 Internal Server Error (pymongo DuplicateKeyError from unique index, logged in backend.err.log). Data stays correct (1 record) but the user gets an error. Fix: wrap insert_one in try/except DuplicateKeyError and return the existing reference with duplicate=True.
No validation that slugs exist / list is complete; partial lists leave duplicate order values.
If content doc is missing, SiteContent(**None) raises TypeError -> 500 instead of a handled 404/defaults.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_enquiry: non-atomic dedupe (see race). Also rate limit counts duplicates of same content, which is fine, but rate check runs after DB service lookup - acceptable.
Rate limiter is in-memory per-process; resets on restart and won't work across multiple replicas.
X-Forwarded-For first value is client-controlled, so rate limit is bypassable by spoofing the header (behind ingress this may be appended rather than replaced - confirm).
reorder endpoint does N sequential updates without validation.

rca of the issue: Concurrent duplicate submit 500: create_enquiry checks for existing submission_key with find_one, then later insert_one. Two requests interleave past the check; unique index on submission_key rejects the second insert with DuplicateKeyError which is unhandled -> 500. Repro: 10 parallel POST /api/enquiries with identical body. Mitigation: try/except DuplicateKeyError -> fetch existing reference and return it.
